provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: For positive densities dx_i/dt=x_i*(r_i-sum_j C_ij*x_j). All coefficients are fixed and public; no demographic noise, seasonal change or migration. Density units are one common controlled survey unit.
audit: A strictly positive coexistence fixed point satisfies C*x=r. Local stability requires all eigenvalues of the full Jacobian to have negative real part; at an interior equilibrium J=-diag(x)*C. An invasion rate is the absent species per-capita growth when the resident alone is at r_resident/C_resident,resident. Report eigenvalues in increasing order. No initial density vector is supplied.
scope: Controlled ecological competition and priority-effect interpretation. Positive equilibrium feasibility alone is not dynamical stability or a global coexistence guarantee.
